# Owl Day House

> Owl Day House is one experienced team for brand experience in Thailand and worldwide: websites and software, touchscreen kiosk games and event interactives, KOL and influencer campaigns, event filming and reviews, digital marketing, and social listening with a partner. Where a client needs the data, the systems we build can connect to the client's own AI through MCP.

Contact: owldayhouse@gmail.com. Prices are provided after discussing a brief.

## Services

- [Websites & Software](https://owldayhouse.com/en/services/website-software/): websites, web and mobile apps, enterprise systems
- [Event Interactive](https://owldayhouse.com/en/services/event-interactive/): touchscreen kiosk games and activities
- [KOL & Influencers](https://owldayhouse.com/en/services/kol-influencer/): selection, planning and creative
- [Event Production](https://owldayhouse.com/en/services/event-content/): event filming and editing
- [Digital Marketing](https://owldayhouse.com/en/services/digital-marketing/): planning, social management, paid ads
- [Social Listening](https://owldayhouse.com/en/services/social-listening/): brand conversation tracking and reports, delivered with a partner

## Industries

- [Education](https://owldayhouse.com/en/industries/education/): open houses and admissions campaigns
- [Property & Automotive](https://owldayhouse.com/en/industries/property-auto/): launches, showrooms and motor show booths
- [Hospitals & Clinics](https://owldayhouse.com/en/industries/healthcare/): KOL campaigns, activities and appointment systems
